description_en: Invokes the UpdateEnhancedVpnGateway operation to modify the name, description, or automatic route propagation feature of an enhanced VPN gateway
description_zh: 调用UpdateEnhancedVpnGateway接口修改增强型VPN网关的名称、描述信息或路由自动传播功能
kebab_example: aliyun vpc update-enhanced-vpn-gateway --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --vpn-gateway-id vpn-bp1q8bgx4xnkm2ogj0000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: UpdateEnhancedVpnGateway

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the enhanced VPN gateway instance. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html operation to query region IDs
parameters.help_zh: 增强型 VPN 网关实例所在的地域 ID。您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html接口获取地域 ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request.

You can generate the parameter value on your client to ensure that the value is unique among different requests. The client token can contain only ASCII characters.

If you do not specify this parameter, the system automatically uses the RequestId of the API request as the ClientToken. The RequestId of each API request is different
parameters.help_zh:
客户端 Token，用于保证请求的幂等性。

从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken 只支持 ASCII 字符。

若您未指定，则系统自动使用 API 请求的 RequestId 作为 ClientToken 标识。每次 API 请求的 RequestId 不一样
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en: The ID of the enhanced VPN gateway instance
parameters.help_zh: 增强型 VPN 网关实例的 ID
parameters.name: vpn_gateway_id

parameters.help_en:
The new name of the enhanced VPN gateway.

The name must be 2 to 100 characters in length. It cannot start with http:// or https://. It must start with a letter and can contain letters, digits, underscores (_), hyphens (-), and periods (.). Other special characters are not supported
parameters.help_zh:
增强型 VPN 网关的新名称。

长度为 2～100 个字符，不能以http://或https://开头，需要以大写或小写字母开头，后面可包含大小写字母、数字、下划线（_）、短划线（-）和半角句号（.），不支持其他特殊字符
parameters.name: name

parameters.help_en:
The new description of the enhanced VPN gateway.

The description must be 1 to 100 characters in length
parameters.help_zh:
增强型 VPN 网关新的描述信息。

描述信息长度为 1～100 个字符
parameters.name: description

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable the automatic route propagation feature of the enhanced VPN gateway. Valid values: true: Enables the feature.
After automatic route propagation is enabled, the enhanced VPN gateway instance automatically learns system routes from the system route table of the VPC and automatically propagates routes from the on-premises data center to the system route table of the VPC. false: Disables the feature.
Before you disable automatic route propagation, make sure that the BGP dynamic route feature is disabled for all IPsec-VPN connections under the enhanced VPN gateway
parameters.help_zh:
是否开启增强型 VPN 网关的路由自动传播功能。取值： true：开启。
开启路由自动传播后，增强型 VPN 网关实例会自动学习 VPC 实例系统路由表中的系统路由，并向 VPC 实例系统路由表自动传播本地数据中心的路由。 false：关闭。
关闭路由自动传播前，请确保增强型 VPN 网关下的所有 IPsec 连接已关闭 BGP 动态路由功能
parameters.name: auto_propagate

AutoPropagate.description_en:
Indicates whether BGP routes are automatically propagated to the VPC. Valid values:
true: automatic propagation

false: no automatic propagation
AutoPropagate.description_zh:
BGP 路由是否自动传播到 VPC。取值：
true：自动传播。

false：不自动传播

CreateTime.description_en:
The timestamp of when the enhanced VPN gateway instance was created. Unit: milliseconds.
The timestamp follows the UNIX time format. It is the total number of milliseconds that have elapsed since the UNIX epoch (January 1, 1970, 00:00:00 UTC) to the time when the enhanced VPN gateway instance was created
CreateTime.description_zh:
增强型 VPN 网关实例的创建时间戳。单位：毫秒。
时间戳的格式采用 Unix 时间戳，表示从格林威治时间 1970 年 01 月 01 日 00 时 00 分 00 秒至创建增强型 VPN 网关实例时的总时长
